name: All Customer Debts
query:
SELECT
  cd.name AS `Reference`,
  cd.customer AS `Customer`,
  cd.dated AS `Date Incurred`,
  cd.payable_amount AS `Payable Amount`,
  cd.amount_paid AS `Amount Paid`,
  cd.balance AS `Balance`,
  cd.status AS `Status`
FROM `tabCustomer Debt` cd
WHERE cd.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR cd.status = %(status)s)
  AND (%(customer)s IS NULL OR %(customer)s = '' OR cd.customer = %(customer)s)
ORDER BY cd.dated DESC
